resources.string: Welcome! The Coconut Disease Image Classification App is a simple and fast model testing app that identifies common coconut tree diseases using your phone’s camera. This app is powered by a TensorFlow Lite model trained over image datasets of coconut diseases to provide instant disease classification using captured image.

A deadly fungal disease that causes the young unopened leaves and bud to rot, leading to tree death. Common cause: Phytophthora palmivora fungus, often spread during prolonged wet or humid conditions.
Caused by leaf-eating caterpillars that chew and damage fronds, reducing photosynthesis and yield. Common cause: Larvae of insects such as Opisina arenosella (coconut leaf caterpillar).
Characterized by drooping and wilted leaves that lose their natural firmness and color. Common cause: Nutrient deficiency (especially potassium or magnesium), water stress, or root damage.
Dark, decaying spots appear on leaves, spreading rapidly during wet seasons and weakening the palm. Common cause: Fungal pathogens like Helminthosporium or Colletotrichum species.
Small, grayish-brown lesions develop on leaves, which later enlarge and merge, reducing leaf health. Common cause: Fungal infection by Pestalotiopsis palmarum, favored by high humidity.
Leaves turn yellow prematurely, starting from the older fronds, leading to reduced growth. Common cause: Nutrient deficiencies (especially nitrogen or magnesium), poor drainage, or pest attack.
